title: Sources: the US Commerce Dept. delayed new Entity List additions for two months, leaving off Megaspeed despite four other US agencies pushing for its inclusion (Financial Times)
summary: Financial Times: Sources: the US Commerce Dept. delayed new Entity List additions for two months, leaving off Megaspeed despite four other US agencies pushing for its inclusion — Company connected to alleged Chinese spy who had affair with Nvidia chief Jensen Huang was left off ‘entity list’
